description: Expected output format for /app/output/diagnosis.json. The forensics pipeline must produce a JSON file matching this schema.

schema.cluster_snapshot_time: ISO 8601 timestamp of the cluster state snapshot
schema.total_indices_analyzed: integer - total number of indices in the ISM explain data

issues.description: List of diagnosed ISM issues. Each issue must be classified into exactly one category.

items.severity: string - one of: critical, high, medium, low
items.category: string - exactly one of: action_failure, policy_version_mismatch, allocation_failure, alias_integrity
items.title: string - brief issue title
items.affected_indices: array of string - sorted list of index names affected by this issue
items.root_cause: string - detailed root cause analysis explaining why the issue occurred

summary.total_issues: integer - number of distinct issues diagnosed
summary.indices_with_failed_actions: integer - count of indices where action.failed=true in ISM explain
summary.indices_with_stale_policy: integer - count of indices with policy_seq_no < current policy _seq_no
summary.indices_with_alias_issues: integer - count of indices affected by alias integrity issues

issue_categories.action_failure: An ISM action (force_merge, allocation, etc.) has failed and is blocking lifecycle progression
issue_categories.policy_version_mismatch: Indices are running a stale policy version, causing behavioral differences
issue_categories.allocation_failure: Shard allocation action is failing due to misconfigured node attributes
issue_categories.alias_integrity: Write alias is not pointing to the correct (latest unrolled) index in a rollover chain

severity_guidelines.critical: Data loss risk or active write failures (e.g., alias pointing to wrong index, allocation preventing required data movement)
severity_guidelines.high: Lifecycle progression blocked but no immediate data loss (e.g., force_merge failure blocking state transitions)
severity_guidelines.medium: Suboptimal configuration without immediate operational impact (e.g., extra replicas from stale policy)
